_meta.description: Toponym names that are cataloguing placeholders, not names (place#216). Each entry is a regular expression matched case-insensitively against the WHOLE trimmed toponym name. 'exclude' removes the name from name-match discovery; 'demote' multiplies its contribution by demote_weight. Records stay in the index and remain reachable by id, by their other names, and spatially. See gateway/placeholders.py.
